tools.emoji-picker.faqs.0.question: Are these emoji free to use?
tools.emoji-picker.faqs.0.answer: Yes. Emoji characters are defined by the Unicode standard and the glyphs are provided by your operating system or device — no license or payment is required to display or copy them.
tools.emoji-picker.faqs.1.question: Why do emoji look different on different devices?
tools.emoji-picker.faqs.1.answer: Each platform (Apple, Google, Microsoft, Samsung…) renders emoji with its own font, so the same character can look slightly different. What you copy is the underlying Unicode character, which works everywhere.
tools.emoji-picker.faqs.2.question: How do I copy an emoji?
tools.emoji-picker.faqs.2.answer: Simply click any emoji and it is copied to your clipboard; paste it anywhere — chats, social media, documents or code.

tools.emoji-picker.guide.intro.paragraph: An emoji picker is a tool that collects the emoji defined by the Unicode standard into categories so you can find and copy the one you need. It is fully free — the glyphs come from your own device fonts.
tools.emoji-picker.guide.sections.0.para: Type in the search box to filter emoji, or switch between categories. Click an emoji to copy it to your clipboard, then paste it anywhere.

tools.video-transcript.title: Video Transcript
tools.video-transcript.description: Paste a YouTube or Bilibili video link to instantly extract the full timestamped transcript. Copy everything or download as a TXT file.
tools.video-transcript.guide.whatIs.body: This tool fetches official or auto-generated subtitles from YouTube and Bilibili video links and converts them into a clean, timestamped text transcript. No video download, no login required, all done in your browser.
tools.video-transcript.guide.howTo.title: How to use
tools.video-transcript.guide.howTo.intro: Three steps to get a transcript:
tools.video-transcript.guide.howTo.items: Paste a YouTube or Bilibili video link into the input box.
Click the extract button and wait a few seconds.
Review the result, copy the full text, or download it as a TXT file.
tools.video-transcript.guide.tips.title: Tips
Some Bilibili videos require login to access subtitles. If you see a no-subtitle error, fill in the SESSDATA cookie from your browser in the advanced options and retry.
YouTube subtitles are official or auto-generated, depending on the video; extraction fails for videos that have no subtitles.
This tool only extracts text subtitles. It does not download any video file.
tools.video-transcript.faqs.0.question: Which platforms are supported?
tools.video-transcript.faqs.0.answer: YouTube and Bilibili, including b23.tv short links and plain BV IDs.
tools.video-transcript.faqs.1.question: Do I need to log in?
tools.video-transcript.faqs.1.answer: No login is needed for YouTube. Some Bilibili subtitles require a logged-in session; fill in the SESSDATA cookie to unlock them.
tools.video-transcript.faqs.2.question: How do I get my Bilibili SESSDATA cookie?
tools.video-transcript.faqs.2.answer: Log in to Bilibili, press F12 to open DevTools, go to Application > Cookies, copy the value of SESSDATA and paste it into the advanced options.
tools.video-transcript.faqs.3.question: Are the transcripts timestamped?
tools.video-transcript.faqs.3.answer: Yes. Every line is prefixed with a mm:ss timestamp so you can locate any part of the video.
tools.video-transcript.faqs.4.question: Does this tool download videos?
tools.video-transcript.faqs.4.answer: No. It only extracts subtitle text. No video content is transmitted or stored.
tools.video-transcript.faqs.5.question: What if a video has no subtitles?
tools.video-transcript.faqs.5.answer: The tool reports that no subtitle is available. For Bilibili, try again after filling in the SESSDATA cookie.

tools.address-generator.faqs.0.question: Which countries are supported?
tools.address-generator.faqs.0.answer: China, United States, United Kingdom, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Russia, Brazil, Netherlands, Australia, Canada, India, Mexico, Türkiye, UAE, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Poland, Sweden and more.
tools.address-generator.faqs.1.question: Are the addresses real?
tools.address-generator.faqs.1.answer: The addresses are randomly generated but follow local naming conventions, making them great as realistic-looking test data.
tools.address-generator.faqs.2.question: Can I generate multiple addresses at once?
tools.address-generator.faqs.2.answer: Yes. Generate up to 20 per batch and export them as CSV for bulk import.
tools.address-generator.faqs.3.question: Where does the data come from?

tools.slideshow-maker.metadata.descripti: Free online tool to combine photos and background music into an MP4 slideshow video with fade transitions and multiple resolutions. All processing happens in your browser.
tools.slideshow-maker.title: Slideshow Video Maker
tools.slideshow-maker.description: Turn your photos into an MP4 slideshow video with optional background music. Choose duration, resolution and transitions — everything runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
tools.slideshow-maker.guide.whatIs.title: What is a Slideshow Video Maker?
This tool combines multiple photos into an MP4 video slideshow. You can add background music and control how long each image is shown, the resolution and the transition effect. Everything is processed locally in your browser using FFmpeg — your images never leave your device.
tools.slideshow-maker.guide.howTo.title: How to use
tools.slideshow-maker.guide.howTo.intro: Create your slideshow in three steps:
Upload two or more images (drag & drop or click to select).
Set the duration per image, resolution, frame rate and transition, and optionally add background music.
Click “Generate Video”, wait for it to finish and download the MP4 file.
tools.slideshow-maker.guide.tips.title: Tips
tools.slideshow-maker.guide.tips.items.0: The fade transition adds a 0.5–1s crossfade between images for a smoother look.
tools.slideshow-maker.guide.tips.items.1: Background music loops automatically to match the video length; a longer track is trimmed to fit.
tools.slideshow-maker.guide.tips.items.2: The video is generated entirely in your browser. Keep the tab open while large images or long videos are processing.
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.0.question: Are my images uploaded?
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.0.answer: No. All processing happens locally in your browser using FFmpeg WebAssembly. Your images and music never leave your device.
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.1.question: Which formats are supported?
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.1.answer: Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP and other formats readable by the browser. Music: MP3, WAV, M4A and other common audio formats. JPG/PNG images are recommended.
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.2.question: Why is the video a bit shorter or longer than expected?
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.2.answer: Total duration = number of images × duration per image − number of transitions × transition length. Choosing the fade transition shortens the video slightly because consecutive images overlap during the crossfade.
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.3.question: What if my music is too short?
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.3.answer: The music loops automatically until the video ends. If the track is longer than the video, it is trimmed to match the video length.
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.4.question: Which resolution should I pick?
tools.slideshow-maker.faqs.4.answer: 720p (1280×720) is the best balance of speed and quality. 1080p is sharper but takes longer to generate. Images are center-cropped to 16:9 automatically.

tools.video-trimmer.title: Video Trimmer
tools.video-trimmer.description: Upload a video, drag to choose the start and end times, and cut out the clip you want — fast lossless trim or precise re-encode. Everything runs locally in your browser.
tools.video-trimmer.guide.whatIs.title: What is a Video Trimmer?
tools.video-trimmer.guide.whatIs.body.0: This tool lets you pick the start and end times of a video and cut out the clip you need in one click. Two modes are available: lossless fast trim (stream copy, done in seconds) and precise re-encode (frame-accurate). Everything runs locally in your browser.
tools.video-trimmer.guide.howTo.title: How to use
tools.video-trimmer.guide.howTo.items.0: Upload a video (drag & drop or click).
tools.video-trimmer.guide.howTo.items.1: Drag the start/end sliders to select the segment you want to keep.
tools.video-trimmer.guide.howTo.items.2: Choose a mode, click “Cut Video” and download the MP4 when done.
tools.video-trimmer.guide.tips.title: Tips
tools.video-trimmer.guide.tips.items.0: Fast (lossless) mode does not re-encode, so it is very fast — great for grabbing long segments.
tools.video-trimmer.guide.tips.items.1: Precise mode re-encodes for frame-accurate cut points.
tools.video-trimmer.guide.tips.items.2: To remove a middle section, cut two parts first, then join them with the Video Joiner.
tools.video-trimmer.faqs.0.question: What is the difference between fast (lossless) and precise (re-encode)?
tools.video-trimmer.faqs.0.answer: Fast mode uses stream copy without re-encoding, so it is very fast but cut points may not be frame-exact. Precise mode re-encodes for frame-accurate cuts at the cost of speed.
tools.video-trimmer.faqs.1.question: Which video formats are supported?
tools.video-trimmer.faqs.1.answer: MP4, WebM, MOV and other formats the browser can read.
tools.video-trimmer.faqs.2.question: Are my videos uploaded?
tools.video-trimmer.faqs.2.answer: No. All processing happens locally in your browser; your video never leaves your device.
tools.video-trimmer.faqs.3.question: Why is the file size almost unchanged after a lossless cut?
tools.video-trimmer.faqs.3.answer: Because lossless mode only copies streams without recompressing, so the size stays close to the source. Precise mode recompresses and is usually smaller.

tools.video-joiner.guide.whatIs.title: What is a Video Joiner?
tools.video-joiner.guide.whatIs.body.0: This tool joins multiple videos into one MP4 in the order you set. When codecs and resolution match, it merges with a lossless stream copy (fast, no quality loss); otherwise it automatically falls back to re-encoding.
tools.video-joiner.guide.howTo.title: How to use
tools.video-joiner.guide.howTo.items.0: Upload two or more videos (multi-select or add repeatedly).
tools.video-joiner.guide.howTo.items.1: Reorder clips with the up/down buttons and remove any you don't need.

tools.video-joiner.guide.tips.title: Tips

tools.video-joiner.guide.tips.items.1: Videos with different codecs automatically take the re-encode path with a small quality loss.
tools.video-joiner.guide.tips.items.2: All processing happens in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
tools.video-joiner.faqs.0.question: Does joining re-encode my videos?
tools.video-joiner.faqs.0.answer: Videos with matching codecs and parameters are joined losslessly via stream copy (fast). If they differ, it automatically falls back to re-encoding.
tools.video-joiner.faqs.1.question: Which video formats are supported?
tools.video-joiner.faqs.1.answer: MP4, WebM, MOV and other formats the browser can read.
tools.video-joiner.faqs.2.question: Why did my merge fail?
tools.video-joiner.faqs.2.answer: It is usually caused by mismatched codecs/resolutions; the re-encode path is tried automatically. We recommend using videos exported with the same settings.
tools.video-joiner.faqs.3.question: Are my videos uploaded?
tools.video-joiner.faqs.3.answer: No. All processing happens locally in your browser.

tools.video-speed-changer.guide.whatIs.b: This tool changes the playback speed of a video — speed it up to 4x or slow it down to 0.25x. The audio is processed with the atempo filter, so the pitch stays the same instead of going squeaky.

tools.video-speed-changer.faqs.1.questio: How fast or slow can I go?

tools.video-subtitle-burner.description: Upload a video and a subtitle file (SRT/ASS/VTT) to burn the subtitles directly into the picture. A custom font is optional. Everything runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

tools.currency-converter.title: Currency Converter
tools.currency-converter.description: Convert between 40+ world currencies with live exchange rates. Everything happens right in your browser — no signup, no data sent to us.
tools.currency-converter.guide.whatIs.bo: This tool converts any amount between 40+ world currencies using live exchange rates. Rates are fetched from free public APIs when you open the page; if the network is unavailable, built-in rates are used instead so the tool keeps working offline.
tools.currency-converter.guide.howTo.ite: Enter the amount you want to convert.
Choose the source currency (From) and target currency (To).
Read the converted amount and the unit rate instantly — no button needed.
tools.currency-converter.guide.tips.item: Use the Swap button to flip the currencies — the amount is carried over automatically.
The offline fallback is a snapshot and may be stale; prefer live rates when accuracy matters.
Rates refresh each time you open the page.
tools.currency-converter.faqs.0.question: How often are the exchange rates updated?
tools.currency-converter.faqs.0.answer: Rates are fetched from free public APIs (European Central Bank data via frankfurter.app, or open.er-api.com) each time the page loads. ECB rates update once per working day; open.er-api updates daily.
tools.currency-converter.faqs.1.question: Does it still work offline?
tools.currency-converter.faqs.1.answer: Yes. If every live API is unreachable, the tool falls back to built-in snapshot rates so you can still convert — just note they may be out of date.
tools.currency-converter.faqs.2.question: Which currencies are supported?
tools.currency-converter.faqs.2.answer: Over 40 major currencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, HKD, KRW and many more.
tools.currency-converter.faqs.3.question: Is my data sent to a server?

tools.image-to-relief.metadata.descripti: Free online tool to turn any photo into a 3D relief. Preview in 3D and export GLB or STL. No signup, fully private — processing happens in your browser.
tools.image-to-relief.title: Image to 3D Relief
tools.image-to-relief.description: Turn any photo into a 3D relief based on its brightness. Preview the result in full 3D and export as GLB or STL — all in your browser.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.whatIs.title: What is an image-to-3D relief tool?
This tool turns any photo into a 3D relief: it maps the image's brightness onto a mesh so bright areas stand out, then lets you preview the result with full 3D controls and export it as GLB (viewers/game engines) or STL (3D printing). Everything runs locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.howTo.title: How to use
Upload an image (JPG, PNG or WebP).
Adjust grid resolution, relief strength and smoothing, then click Generate 3D.
Preview the mesh (drag to rotate, scroll to zoom), then download GLB or STL.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.tips.title: Tips
tools.image-to-relief.guide.tips.items.0: Images with strong contrast produce more dramatic reliefs.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.tips.items.1: Increase smoothing to reduce noise on detailed photos.
tools.image-to-relief.guide.tips.items.2: For 3D printing, choose STL — the model is automatically laid flat for slicing.
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.0.question: How is the 3D relief generated?
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.0.answer: The tool reads each pixel's brightness (luminance) and lifts the mesh height accordingly — bright areas rise, dark areas stay low. Parameters let you control resolution, height and smoothing.
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.1.question: What's the difference between GLB and STL?
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.1.answer: GLB is a general 3D format for viewers and game engines. STL is the standard format for 3D printing and is exported pre-oriented flat.
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.2.question: Is my image uploaded?
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.2.answer: No. All processing happens in your browser; your image never leaves your device.
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.3.question: Why does my result look flat?
tools.image-to-relief.faqs.3.answer: Low-contrast images produce subtle reliefs. Try increasing relief strength, lowering smoothing, or using a photo with stronger lighting contrast.

tools.image-to-printmaking.metadata.titl: Image to Printmaking - Free Online Tool
tools.image-to-printmaking.metadata.desc: Free online tool to turn photos into black & white printmaking art with an adjustable threshold and instant preview. No uploads — all in your browser.
tools.image-to-printmaking.title: Image to Printmaking
tools.image-to-printmaking.description: Turn any photo into a black & white printmaking effect. A precise threshold removes grayscale transitions so only pure black and white remain — like a woodcut or screen print.
This tool converts any photo into a black & white printmaking style in one click. A precise threshold algorithm removes grayscale transitions so only pure black and pure white remain, mimicking traditional woodcut, screen print or old letterpress effects.
tools.image-to-printmaking.guide.howTo.i: Upload an image (JPG, PNG or WebP).
Drag the threshold slider to balance black and white areas — the preview updates instantly.
Download the final printmaking image as PNG.
tools.image-to-printmaking.guide.tips.it: Photos with strong contrast produce bolder printmaking effects.
Lower thresholds turn more of the image black; higher thresholds keep more white.
Enable Invert to swap black and white for a negative-like look.
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.0.questi: How does the printmaking effect work?
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.0.answer: The tool converts each pixel to grayscale, then applies a threshold: pixels darker than the threshold become black, the rest become white. No gray tones remain, which creates the classic woodcut look.
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.1.questi: Is my image uploaded to a server?
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.1.answer: No. Everything runs locally in your browser — your image never leaves your device.
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.2.questi: What is the best threshold value?
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.2.answer: It depends on your image. Start around 128 and adjust: lower values make more of the image black, higher values keep more white. Use the live preview to find the best balance.
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.3.questi: Can I get the opposite colors?
tools.image-to-printmaking.faqs.3.answer: Yes, enable the Invert option to swap black and white.

tools.image-emboss.metadata.title: Image Emboss - Free Online Tool
tools.image-emboss.metadata.description: Free online tool to turn any photo into an embossed stone/metal carving effect. Adjustable strength with instant preview. No uploads — all processing happens in your browser.
tools.image-emboss.title: Image Emboss
tools.image-emboss.description: Turn any photo into an embossed relief with a pixel-difference algorithm that extracts edges and contours — like stone carving or metal stamping.
tools.image-emboss.guide.whatIs.title: What is an image emboss tool?
tools.image-emboss.guide.whatIs.body.0: This tool applies an emboss filter to any photo: a pixel-difference algorithm highlights edges and contours by comparing each pixel with its neighbors, producing a realistic stone-carving or metal-stamping look in seconds.
tools.image-emboss.guide.howTo.title: How to use
tools.image-emboss.guide.howTo.items.0: Upload an image (JPG, PNG or WebP).
tools.image-emboss.guide.howTo.items.1: Adjust the strength slider to control how pronounced the emboss is — the preview updates instantly.
tools.image-emboss.guide.howTo.items.2: Download the embossed image as PNG.
tools.image-emboss.guide.tips.title: Tips
tools.image-emboss.guide.tips.items.0: Images with strong edges and details produce the most dramatic emboss.
tools.image-emboss.guide.tips.items.1: Lower strength gives a subtle texture; higher strength creates a bold stone-carved look.
tools.image-emboss.guide.tips.items.2: Enable Invert to flip which side of the edges is raised.
tools.image-emboss.faqs.0.question: How does the emboss effect work?
tools.image-emboss.faqs.0.answer: The tool compares each pixel with its neighbors using a convolution kernel. Areas with little change become mid-gray, while edges become bright or dark — creating the 3D carved look.
tools.image-emboss.faqs.1.question: Is my image uploaded to a server?
tools.image-emboss.faqs.1.answer: No. Everything runs locally in your browser — your image never leaves your device.
tools.image-emboss.faqs.2.question: What is the best strength value?
tools.image-emboss.faqs.2.answer: It depends on your image. Start at 1.0 and adjust: lower values give a subtle texture, higher values create a bolder, deeper carving.
tools.image-emboss.faqs.3.question: Why is the result mostly gray?
tools.image-emboss.faqs.3.answer: That's the classic emboss look — flat areas render as mid-gray, and only edges stand out in light and dark. Increase the strength for a stronger effect.

tools.id-photo-generator.metadata.title: ID Photo Generator
tools.id-photo-generator.metadata.descri: Turn a portrait photo into a passport or ID photo. Choose official size and background, fine-tune framing, download a print-ready PNG — 100% local.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.0.question: Is this ID photo generator free?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.0.answer: Yes, completely free. No registration, no watermarks, no hidden fees. All processing happens locally in your browser.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.1.question: What ID sizes are supported?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.1.answer: We support US passport/visa (2×2 in), EU/UK passport (35×45 mm), China passport (33×48 mm), Japan passport (45×35 mm), 1×1 inch (25×25 mm), small ID (30×40 mm), plus Chinese 1-inch (25×35 mm) and 2-inch (35×49 mm) photos. All sizes output at 300 DPI.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.2.question: Can I change the background color?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.2.answer: Yes. Choose white, blue, red or gray — the chosen color is placed behind your photo.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.3.question: What if my photo isn't perfectly centered?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.3.answer: Use the X/Y offset sliders to move the photo and the zoom slider to control how large the face appears.
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.4.question: Is my photo uploaded to a server?
tools.id-photo-generator.faqs.4.answer: No. The AI background removal and all rendering happen entirely in your browser using WebAssembly — your photo never leaves your device.
tools.id-photo-generator.labels.dropProm: Upload a portrait to create an ID photo
tools.id-photo-generator.labels.processi: AI is processing your photo, please wait
tools.id-photo-generator.errors.failed: Background removal failed. Please try another photo.
tools.id-photo-generator.guide.whatIs.ti: What is an ID photo generator?
tools.id-photo-generator.guide.whatIs.bo: This tool makes passport, visa and ID photos in your browser. Upload a portrait, and the AI removes the background so you can place your face on any official background color (white, blue, red or gray). Pick one of the international sizes — all rendered at 300 DPI print quality — adjust zoom and position, and download a high-quality PNG. Your photo never leaves your device.
tools.id-photo-generator.guide.howTo.ite: Upload a front-facing portrait photo with a plain, well-lit background.
Choose your target ID size and background color. Use the zoom and offset controls to frame the face correctly.
Download a high-quality PNG, ready to print or submit digitally.
tools.id-photo-generator.guide.tips.body: Well-lit, front-facing photos with both ears visible and a natural expression work best.
Keep the face centered — zoom and offset controls fine-tune the composition.
White is the most common background for passport photos; check your destination country's requirements.
tools.background-replace.metadata.title: Background Replace - Free Online Tool
tools.background-replace.metadata.descri: Remove a photo's background and replace it with a solid color, gradient, a custom image, or a blurred version of the original. AI powered, runs entirely in your browser.
tools.background-replace.title: Background Replace
tools.background-replace.description: Remove the background of any photo and replace it with a solid color, gradient, a custom image, or a blurred version of the original. The AI cutout and all rendering happen locally in your browser.
tools.background-replace.faqs.0.question: Is the background replace free?
tools.background-replace.faqs.0.answer: Yes. This tool is completely free with no signup, no watermarks, and no usage limits. Everything runs locally in your browser.
tools.background-replace.faqs.1.question: What background options are available?
tools.background-replace.faqs.1.answer: You can choose a solid color (with a palette and custom color picker), a two-color gradient, a custom background image, or a blurred version of the original photo with adjustable strength.
tools.background-replace.faqs.2.question: Is my photo uploaded to a server?
tools.background-replace.faqs.2.answer: No. The AI background removal uses WebAssembly and runs entirely in your browser, so your photo never leaves your device.
tools.background-replace.faqs.3.question: What file formats can I use?
tools.background-replace.faqs.3.answer: You can upload PNG, JPG, WEBP and BMP images. The result is always downloaded as a high-quality PNG file.
tools.background-replace.upload.drop: Drop a photo or click to upload
tools.background-replace.errors.replace: Failed to replace the background. Please try another image.
tools.background-replace.guide.whatIs.ti: What Is the Background Replace Tool?
tools.background-replace.guide.whatIs.bo: This tool removes the background of any photo using an AI model that runs in your browser, then lets you place the cut-out subject on a new background: a solid color, a gradient, a custom image, or a blurred version of the original photo.
Because everything is processed locally with WebAssembly, your photos never leave your device and the tool is free to use with no limits.
tools.background-replace.guide.howTo.ite: Drop or upload the photo you want to edit.
Choose a background mode: solid, gradient, image, or blur.
Tune the settings — color, direction, image, or blur strength.
Click Replace Background and wait a few seconds.
Download the result as a high-quality PNG.
